Tsugumi documents

The concept, and a walkthrough with real screens, are in the README. Start from the document that fits what you want to read. To read with moving figures, there is the web version (the same documents). For AI, llms.txt points to the Markdown of each page.

Getting started

DocumentContents
INSTALL.mdInstalling and updating the desktop app and the tsugumi command (Mac, Linux, Windows), and building from source
Usage.mdGetting started by following a demo's guide, and the operations you use most
CardGuide.mdYour first Card: a Card that takes an input and computes, written in Python, bash, C++, R and Julia (a test runs the code on this page)

The ideas

DocumentContents
Philosophy.md"What to build so that we are not used by AI": the concern behind Tsugumi, where it started, its name, how it was built and its author
Rationale.mdWhy design, implementation and checking share one Workflow: answers to the three reasons for hesitating to hand research to AI (an invisible process, reproducibility, data), the measures that keep trial and error light, and where to check each
Vision.mdApplications: learning research decisions, growing tools, handing work to the next person, and the idea of business automation
Limitations.mdThe current scope, plans and the scope of the guarantees

features.mdA technical tour of the main features (architecture, Cards and Workflows, Nix, SDK and workers, saving, history, visualisation, UI, Agent, demos)
